title: Vision Token Pruning via Query-Vision Interaction Decomposition
abstract: arXiv:2610.33215v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Large vision-language models (VLMs), which process both visual inputs and text queries, incur high inference costs due to the large number of visual tokens, making visual token pruning a natural approach for improving efficiency. Recent work has leveraged query information to guide token selection, often through heuristics derived from attention patterns or token dynamics. However, these approaches do not explicitly exploit the underlying structure of query-vision interactions. We address this gap by observing that the query-vision interaction matrix, naturally induced by the query and key projections already present in transformer attention, is effectively low-rank, with a small number of dominant latent interaction modes capturing query-relevant semantics. Motivated by this observation, we propose Query-Vision Decomposition (QViD), a novel training-free query-aware visual token pruning method that exploits this structure. Extensive exp

translated_title: 基于查询-视觉交互分解的视觉令牌剪枝
translated_abstract: 同时处理视觉输入和文本查询的大型视觉语言模型（VLM），由于视觉令牌数量庞大而产生高昂的推理成本，这使得视觉令牌剪枝成为提升效率的天然途径。近期工作利用查询信息来指导令牌选择，通常采用从注意力模式或令牌动态中推导的启发式方法。然而，这些方法并未显式地利用查询-视觉交互的底层结构。我们通过观察发现，由Transformer注意力中已有的查询和键投影自然诱导的查询-视觉交互矩阵实际上是低秩的，即少量主导的潜在交互模式即可捕获与查询相关的语义，从而填补了这一空白。受此观察启发，我们提出了查询-视觉分解（QViD），这是一种新颖的免训练、查询感知的视觉令牌剪枝方法，能够利用这种结构。大量实验……
tldr: 提出QViD方法，利用查询-视觉交互矩阵的低秩结构，实现免训练的查询感知视觉令牌剪枝，以降低视觉语言模型的推理成本。
en_tdlr: Proposes QViD, a training-free query-aware visual token pruning method that exploits the low-rank structure of the query-vision interaction matrix to reduce inference costs in large vision-language models.
